run_make_dataset: run the script to parse a text file into a train/valid/test JSON dataset
create_tokenize_function: create a function that tokenizes text using spaCy English tokenizer and returns space-joined tokens
parse_text_to_json_dataset: parse a text file with grouped examples and JSON annotations into a structured JSON dataset
split_dataset_train_valid_test: split parsed examples into train, valid, and test sets and save as JSON
review_tokenize: review the tokenize function that uses spaCy English tokenizer to split and rejoin text tokens
